# Vanesa Chetrusca — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Vanesa Chetrusca, a Computer Science & AI student at Queen Mary University of London, showcasing projects in web development, machine learning, and software engineering.

The site is a single-page React application. Project details and writing posts are loaded dynamically, so the links below point to the main entry pages where that content is listed.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://vanesachetruscaportfolio.vercel.app/): Introduction, featured projects, and overview.
- [Projects](https://vanesachetruscaportfolio.vercel.app/projects): Full list of software, web, and ML projects with detail pages.
- [Writing](https://vanesachetruscaportfolio.vercel.app/writing): Blog posts and articles.

## Optional

- [robots.txt](https://vanesachetruscaportfolio.vercel.app/robots.txt): Crawler directives.
- [Sitemap](https://vanesachetruscaportfolio.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of indexable pages.
